content: Root cause: The bug was caused by incorrect handling of the "ListenPort" configuration in the WireGuard section, specifically when the input value was either empty or set to "auto". The original code did not properly set the port value to 0 in these cases, leading to potential misconfigurations or undefined behavior. The patch corrects this by explicitly setting the port to 0 when the input is empty or "auto", ensuring that the configuration is handled correctly.
